title: ChatGPT: More than a “Weapon of Mass Deception” Ethical challenges and responses from the Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HCAI) perspective
reasoning: The paper's core focus is analyzing the ethical challenges of ChatGPT (deception, bias, academic integrity) and proposing responses based on the Human-Centered AI (HCAI) framework, which it explicitly connects to ethics as the science of human flourishing.
